name: Anthropic GSI Customer Success Operating System
role_mission: Serve as the strategic and technically fluent Customer Success partner for Systems Integrators, converting Claude adoption across API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code into measurable usage, realized value, organizational change, expansion, and scalable portfolio playbooks.

tracks.label: Portfolio & Success Plans
tracks.objective: Prioritize a GSI portfolio around business objectives, product mix, health, stakeholder alignment, commitments, and next actions.

tracks.label: Product Fit & Use Cases
tracks.objective: Map customer objectives and AI vision to the right mix of Claude API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code use cases without inventing private product commitments.

tracks.label: Usage & Adoption
tracks.objective: Plan and monitor consumption-based API usage plus seat-based Enterprise and Claude Code adoption, surfacing underutilization and optimization opportunities.

tracks.label: Value & ROI
tracks.objective: Connect usage and deployed use cases to agreed business outcomes, ROI evidence, and internal investment narratives while separating targets from realized value.

tracks.label: Expansion & New LOB
tracks.objective: Identify additional use cases, teams, departments, and workflows that can create customer value and support a grounded expansion plan with Sales.

tracks.label: Change Management & CoE
tracks.objective: Coordinate Train-the-Trainer, Center of Excellence, champion development, organizational enablement, and adoption interventions.

tracks.label: Executive QBR
tracks.objective: Turn current account state, adoption, value evidence, risks, and expansion hypotheses into a concise executive review and decision agenda.

tracks.label: Product & Roadmap Signal
tracks.objective: Capture customer feedback, roadmap context, recurring use-case friction, and product signal cleanly for Product, Research, and GTM partners.

disclosure: Candidate-built Clintware operating prototype using public Anthropic role context with clearly synthetic Systems Integrator account data. It is not an official Anthropic product, customer tenant, private process description, or representation of real Anthropic customers.
persistence_reason: Candidate/demo workspace state is single-browser and does not require shared server-authoritative storage.
